integrity: Exact combinatorial and generating-function proof plus geometric-renewal CLT. Independent audit not performed; finite executable checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Specific to uniformly sampled labeled permutation-graph trees. Prior published run encoding supplies the combinatorial model. This work proves a conditional majorization consequence and exact quadratic-degree dependence and joint asymptotics; historical priority is not absolutely settled.
title: Diameter-conditioned degree majorization and quadratic-degree fluctuations in random permutation trees
